name: cascade_delete
description: Detected in the DELETE endpoint function delete_customer: it explicitly deletes child rows with db.query(Order).filter(Order.o_custkey == c_custkey).delete(...) before deleting the parent Customer row. This matches an application-level cascade delete, and the separate read endpoint orders_history depends on Order rows, so deleting a customer permanently removes orders that /api/orders/history expects to return.
